overlay.rtest.scene.active: RTest RT scene active; press F8 to stop
overlay.rtest.smokeTest.failed: RTest RT smoke test failed; see latest.log
screen.rtest.settings.title: RTest Vulkan Ray Tracing
screen.rtest.settings.sunColorTemperatur: Adjust direct sunlight color; lower is warmer, higher is cooler.
screen.rtest.settings.ambientColorTemper: Adjust sky/environment light color; lower is warmer, higher is cooler.
Adjust direct sunlight, physical shadowing, and the sun path.
screen.rtest.settings.category.pathTraci: Adjust GI intensity and path layers; higher values can increase noise and GPU cost.
screen.rtest.settings.category.reconstru: FSR3 handles temporal reconstruction and upscaling, not RT denoising.
Use either NRD or Sundial; observe a few frames after switching.
screen.rtest.settings.shadowStrength.tip: How strongly shadows affect direct sunlight.
screen.rtest.settings.volumetricLighting: Enable Prime-inspired single-scattering sun shafts and aerial perspective; disable to restore the old cost.
Strength of aerial perspective and sun-volume scattering; higher values are hazier and brighter.
screen.rtest.settings.volumetricFogDensi: Controls world-distance fog independently; higher values shorten visibility without directly brightening sun shafts.
screen.rtest.settings.volumetricLighting: Controls per-pixel aerial-perspective integration steps; Performance also skips the terrain-shadow query.
screen.rtest.settings.sunAngleOffset.tip: Offsets Minecraft's sun angle in time without changing the path direction.
screen.rtest.settings.sunAzimuthOffset.t: Rotates the sun path around the vertical axis: 0° = east-to-west, 90° = north-to-south.
screen.rtest.settings.dynamicEntityMvpEn: Upload capturable vanilla entity and block-entity geometry to dynamic BLAS/TLAS; unsupported layers are redrawn by vanilla after the RT output.
screen.rtest.settings.giBounces.tip: Number of GI continuation rays per path; the Primary ray is not counted.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrFormat.tip: LabPBR uses R=smoothness, G=metalness, B=porosity, A=emission; Classic and BedrockRTX use their native channel layouts.
Scales tangent-space normal-map XY and reconstructs a stable Z component.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrTextureAoEnable: Use the LabPBR normal-map blue channel as texture AO, matching Sundial; off by default to preserve albedo.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrPorosityEnabled: Decode LabPBR porosity and reduce roughness under rain according to the material's wet response.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrEmissionStrengt: Multiplier for authored PBR emissive channels, up to 20x; the LabPBR alpha 255 sentinel remains non-emissive.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrPredefinedMetal: Decode LabPBR metal IDs 230-237 into the Iteration/Sundial predefined metal F0 values.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrTerrainCpuCaptu: Keep terrain sprite IDs so companion normal/specular textures can be sampled in RT; disabling restores compiled-mesh performance with neutral PBR fallback.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrParallaxEnabled: Run tangent-space parallax occlusion mapping from normal companion alpha height; this changes material UVs, not the coarse RT mesh.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrEntityParallaxE: Apply the same height-based UV displacement to entities, items, and block entities.
screen.rtest.settings.pbrParallaxDepth.t: Height displacement scale; 1.0 matches Sundial's default.
screen.rtest.settings.fluidRtEnabled.tip: Use fluid-aware RT capture for water and lava; disable to use the compiled-terrain fallback.
screen.rtest.settings.hdrEnabled.tip: Use the linear scRGB HDR path on native Wayland when the display exposes it; restart after changing this option.
screen.rtest.settings.fsrQuality.tip: FSR3 render-resolution and temporal reconstruction quality preset.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdEnabled.tip: Enable NRD 4.17.3 ReBLUR for opaque primary surfaces; Sundial remains mutually exclusive.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdStrength.tip: Blend stochastic indirect and reflected lighting toward NRD; direct light and visible emission retain raw detail.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdHitDistanceReco: Reconstruct invalid hit distances; 3x3 is a balanced default, 5x5 is smoother, and off is for clean signals.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdDiffusePrepassB: Diffuse pre-pass radius; lower values retain detail, higher values reduce noise.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdSpecularPrepass: Specular pre-pass radius; raise it for noisy highlights, but excessive values spread highlights.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdMinHitDistanceW: Minimum hit-distance weight in spatial filtering; higher values reduce shadow sensitivity.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdMinBlurRadius.t: Minimum spatial blur radius after convergence.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdMaxBlurRadius.t: Maximum spatial blur radius used with short history.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdLobeAngleFracti: Normal-edge rejection sensitivity relative to the diffuse/specular lobe angle.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdRoughnessFracti: Roughness-edge rejection sensitivity; very low values can break material edges.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdPlaneDistanceSe: Allowed deviation from the local tangent plane; high values can ghost.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdFastHistoryClam: Color-box Sigma used when clamping main history to fast history.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdFireflySuppress: Firefly suppression floor; lower values suppress more but can remove highlights.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdDisocclusionThr: Relative-depth disocclusion threshold; lower values reduce ghosting, higher values are more stable but can leak history.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdMaxAccumulatedF: Maximum NRD main-history frames; higher values stabilize noise but respond more slowly to changes.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdMaxFastAccumula: Maximum NRD fast-history frames; it is clamped to the main history.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdHistoryFixFrame: Number of spatially reconstructed frames after a history reset.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdAntiFirefly.tip: Suppress sparse bright samples from stochastic emissive hits. This adds one pass, while both large-radius prepasses remain off by default.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdSpecularPrepass: Use the specular pre-pass for motion estimation without feeding it into visible specular filtering.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdHistoryFixPixel: Sampling stride of the 5x5 history-fix kernel; lower values are steadier but can be softer.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdConvergenceScal: REBLUR convergence scale; higher values reduce spatial blur faster.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdConvergenceBase: Extra convergence base used during short history.
screen.rtest.settings.nrdConvergencePerc: Maximum-history fraction affected by the short-history convergence base.
Maximum valid view-space distance; too low makes distant terrain look like sky.
screen.rtest.settings.sundialDenoiserEna: Sundial-style temporal-spatial denoiser; mutually exclusive with NRD.
screen.rtest.settings.sundialDenoiserStr: Blend between raw RT and the Sundial temporal-spatial result.
screen.rtest.settings.sundialDenoiserHis: Maximum Sundial history frames; values that are too high can ghost.
screen.rtest.settings.category.output.de: Manage Prime color output, HDR, and offline accumulation.
screen.rtest.settings.primeColorManageme: Apply Prime 26.3 gamut compression, highlight rolloff, and hue repair to SDR output; off keeps only linear BT.709 to sRGB encoding.
screen.rtest.settings.hdrWideGamutEnable: Experimentally select a linear Rec.2020 surface; enable only when the compositor converts it correctly, then restart.
screen.rtest.settings.nativeColorDecodeE: Decode sRGB output from vanilla entities, UI, and effects into the HDR linear target; restart or reload resources after changing it.
screen.rtest.settings.offlineRender.tip: Freeze camera, scene, sun, weather, and atlas animation while a GPU RGBA32F running mean accumulates. Shortcut: Right Alt + F2.
